newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: BANGLADESH TEA PRICES RISE ON OVERSEAS DEMAND.
newsitem.headline: BANGLADESH TEA PRICES RISE ON OVERSEAS DEMAND.

text.p: Bangladeshi tea prices rose on overseas demand at the weekly auction, brokers said on Tuesday.
Brokers said buyers for Poland, Pakistan, Afghanistan and Russia bid strongly, lifting mostly bold brokens and fannings grades. Internal buyers and blenders were also active.
The average price was 72.96 taka per kg, up 0.88 taka from the previous sale. Some 929,927 kg of teas were sold at the auction.
The next sale will be held on August 19 with an offer of 1.125 million kg of teas.
